title.zh: 币安推出Binance Intelligence AI产品栈，包含Binance AI、AI Pro与Agent OS
title.en: 【币安推出 AI 产品栈 Binance Intelligence，包含 AI Pro 与 Agent OS 等】

current_state.zh:
币安向所有英语用户开放了Binance AI——一个免费的生成式界面（generative UI）交易工具，此前该产品处于测试阶段，约有15万名测试者参与。

币安是按交易量计算最大的交易所，将AI驱动的界面开放给其全部英语零售用户，意味着AI工具从测试性实验进入主流交易流程。

Binance AI是一套免费功能组合，将图表、新闻、社交媒体、链上数据和研究工具的市场信号整合到单一界面中，并通过生成式界面适配不同用户的知识水平。本次开放范围限于英语用户。
current_state.en: Binance launched Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users following a beta that involved roughly 150,000 testers.

updates.title_zh: 【币安推出 AI 产品栈 Binance Intelligence，包含 AI Pro 与 Agent OS 等】
updates.title_en: 【币安推出 AI 产品栈 Binance Intelligence，包含 AI Pro 与 Agent OS 等】
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安宣布推出 Binance Intelligence，这是一个由三部分组成的 AI 产品栈，包括面向消费者的免费产品 Binance AI、可将自然语言转化为可执行策略的 Binance AI Pro，以及面向开发者的 Binance Agent OS，自 10 月 5 日起陆续上线。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance announced Binance Intelligence, a three-part AI product stack comprising a free consumer Binance AI, Binance AI Pro that converts natural language into executable strategies, and Binance Agent OS for developers, rolling out starting October 5.

updates.what_changed_zh: Agent OS 自 8 月上线以来日调用量已超过 28 万次。
updates.what_changed_en: Agent OS has surpassed 280,000 daily calls since its August launch.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安宣布 Binance Intelligence AI 产品栈，包含免费消费者版 Binance AI、可将自然语言转化为可执行策略的 Binance AI Pro，以及面向开发者的 Binance Agent OS，自 10 月 5 日起推出；Agent OS 自 8 月上线以来日调用量已超过 28 万次。
updates.current_state_en: Binance announced Binance Intelligence, a three-part AI product stack comprising a free consumer Binance AI, Binance AI Pro that converts natural language into executable strategies, and Binance Agent OS for developers, rolling out starting October 5; Agent OS has surpassed 280,000 daily calls since its August launch.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance announced Binance Intelligence, an AI suite spanning a free consumer assistant, an AI Pro tier that converts natural-language trading ideas into executable strategies and automated workflows, and Agent OS for developers building AI agents, with Agent OS surpassing 280,000 daily calls since its August launch.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance announced Binance Intelligence, an AI suite spanning a free consumer assistant, an AI Pro tier that converts natural-language trading ideas into executable strategies and automated workflows, and Agent OS for developers building AI agents, with Agent OS surpassing 280,000 daily calls since its August launch.

币安向所有英语用户开放了Binance AI——一个免费的生成式界面（generative UI）交易工具，此前该产品处于测试阶段，约有15万名测试者参与。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance launched Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users following a beta that involved roughly 150,000 testers.
updates.background_zh: 币安此前已提供较为完整的自动化工具组合，包括现货网格、合约网格和套利机器人，并发布了用于连接其交易API的AI agent技能文档。生成式界面（generative UI）指让大语言模型不仅输出文本，还直接生成界面元素，从而按用户需求定制交互界面。
updates.background_en: Binance already offers a large built-in automation suite, including spot grid, futures grid and arbitrage bots, and has published documentation for AI agent skills that connect to its trading APIs. Generative UI refers to letting a large language model generate interface elements rather than only text, producing interfaces tailored to a user's request.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次发布影响的是币安面向零售用户的入口，而非市场结构本身：如果该界面将图表、新闻、社交媒体与链上信号集中到一处，可能影响英语零售用户在币安上的下单路径与情绪判断方式。事件不涉及上币、费率或监管变更。
updates.market_impact_en: The rollout affects Binance's retail-facing channel rather than market structure: if the interface concentrates chart, news, social and onchain signals into one place, it could influence how English-language retail users route orders and interpret sentiment on the venue. No listing, fee or regulatory change is involved.
